name: rtfx
description: Publish local HTML, PDF, and multi-file artifacts from Claude Desktop to rtfx.pro with versioned, access-controlled stable URLs.
long_description: rtfx.pro is private, access-controlled hosting for artifacts Claude builds. This Desktop Extension installs a local MCP server inside Claude Desktop, so Claude can publish a local file or folder by path, list artifacts, inspect versions, roll back, and check the connection. It uses browser OAuth credentials stored locally, or an optional scoped RTFX_API_TOKEN for advanced users. It never needs Cloudflare account credentials.

tools.name: publish
tools.description: Publish a local HTML/PDF file, zip, or folder to rtfx.pro and return the stable URL. The server runs locally inside Claude Desktop, so paths refer to files on this machine.

tools.name: list_artifacts
tools.description: List artifacts visible to the configured rtfx credential.

tools.name: get_versions
tools.description: Show immutable versions for one artifact slug.

tools.name: rollback
tools.description: Move an artifact's current pointer back to an earlier immutable version.

tools.name: doctor
tools.description: Check credential source, endpoint, scopes, local Node runtime, and available tools.

artifacts_url.title: rtfx endpoint
artifacts_url.description: rtfx.pro instance URL. Leave as https://rtfx.pro unless you self-host.

rtfx_api_token.title: API token (optional)
rtfx_api_token.description: Optional scoped rtfx API token. Leave blank to use browser sign-in stored by the rtfx CLI/plugin.

allow_access_management.title: Expose access-management tool
allow_access_management.description: Expose update_access in Claude Desktop. Requires a token with manage scope. Leave off unless you intentionally want Claude to change who can open artifacts.
